own: Again, I don't see why we can't just have a drop-down menu with the list of the currencies that they support and are willing to pay in, and then the person who clicks on the ad can select the currency and then another drop-down and select the payment type. This can all be done on a single ad. Now, this is as long as those items that they're putting in the drop-downs are indexed so they are caught in the searches when people are looking for vendors.
question: Should the line "Each offer can cover several currencies." stay off the screen until that feature ships?
